property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, C always makes external calls that decode to transferFrom(address,address,uint256) on the callee (the recorder will observe calls with that exact selector and decoded args); the mutant replacing the selector with a wrong one causes the recorder to observe zero decoded transferFrom calls (or different selector) for some inputs.
change_summary: Change the bytes4 selector computation to an incorrect selector so the external calls will likely revert/do nothing compared to original selector.
